verdict.rationale: Cloud Identity documentation shows dynamic groups exist ("Creating a dynamic group"), and the Admin console lets admins apply settings such as 2-Step Verification enforcement to specific groups. However, the pack has no evidence of membership rule syntax or of assigning apps such as SAML or SSO apps by group. missing for 10: documented dynamic-membership rule details, group-based app assignment evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, access is assigned by group and rule — dynamic group membership and group-based app assignment replace one-by-one grants
